hero.name: Md. Ayubur Rahaman
hero.statement: I build high-performance web, mobile, and AI-powered applications focused on scalability, seamless user experiences, and intelligent automation.

about.label: // about
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Software Engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, currently working as a Software Engineer II at ShellBeeHaken Ltd., with 6 years of experience building scalable web and mobile applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, React Native, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.

Beyond traditional full-stack development, I'm passionate about AI engineering and Agentic AI systems. I design and deliver intelligent applications powered by LLMs, RAG pipelines, AI agents (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MCP), and real-time communication technologies — combining modern software engineering with practical AI solutions.

I focus on building maintainable, scalable, and high-performance systems with clean architecture and thoughtful developer experience. I also mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and design discussions, and lead technical scoping for feature teams.

items.name: FAM Sports Nutrition Learning Platform
items.description: An interactive learning platform training professional sports nutrition advisors through structured courses and one-on-one consultations, across web and mobile.
outcomes: Developed and maintained both the admin and customer-facing web apps (Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI), plus built a cross-platform mobile app for iOS and Android.
Shipped an AI-powered chat feature providing real-time learning guidance and user support, alongside consultation modules connecting users with professional nutritionists.
Implemented end-to-end Stripe payment and subscription flows, enabling flexible content access and recurring revenue for 1K+ subscribers.

items.name: KriyaKarak
items.description: A secure platform unifying service providers from across Bangladesh onto a single digital marketplace.
outcomes: Owned the Expert Portfolio Module end-to-end — frontend architecture, UI, and feature integration.
Improved service scheduling and booking workflows in the Booking Module for 5K+ service providers.

items.name: Mapage
items.description: A branding platform for freelance beauticians in Japan, enabling them to build a personal brand and offer beauty services to customers
outcomes: Developed and maintained customer-facing web app, plus built a cross-platform mobile app for iOS and Android.
Implemented the stylist portfolio management module, allowing beauticians to showcase their work and personal brand effectively.

items.name: Gorillamove: Grocery delivery
items.description: An instant grocery delivery service in Bangladesh, commited to effectively serving customers and the planet a little better every day.
outcomes: Owned total mobile frontend architecture to design, develop, and integrate core features and functionalities
Implemented payment gateway systems on the frontend.

impact: Architected and shipped scalable full-stack applications with Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL, including complex aggregation pipelines and query optimization.

Designed and delivered Agentic AI solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and MCP — automating customer support and evaluation systems, reducing manual processing effort by 20% for 1K+ users.
Developed cross-platform mobile apps with React Native, shipped to both iOS and Android from a single codebase with 5K+ downloads.
Built event-driven workflows using AWS Lambda, WebSockets, and Redis, sustaining 10K concurrent connections for real-time features and background processing.
Containerized services with Docker for consistent development and production deployments.
Mentor 12+ junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and design discussions; lead technical scoping for 7-person feature teams.
Created reusable, usability-driven UI component patterns adopted across 3 company web properties, cutting new page development time by 20%.
Designed and supported the UI for the organization's ERP system in Angular, serving 5K+ internal users across departments.
Built and integrated the company's e-commerce platform using React.js and Next.js, supporting 100K monthly visitors.
Built and shipped a cross-platform mobile application with React Native, released on both app stores.
Developed backend services in PHP with optimized PostgreSQL schemas and queries.
